factories.name: new_list_forms_step
factories.description: List one page, 1 to 200 forms, of the account's forms, optionally filtered by a search string or workspace.

inputSchema.description: ListFormsInput selects one page of the account's forms.

page.description: Page is the 1-based page number; zero reads the first page.

pageSize.description: PageSize is 1 to 200 forms per page; zero uses Typeform's default of 10.

search.description: Search returns only forms whose title contains this text; blank lists every form.

workspaceId.description: WorkspaceID lists only the forms of one workspace, such as the ID in https://admin.typeform.com/accounts/<account>/workspaces/<workspaceId>; blank lists every workspace.

factories.name: new_get_form_step
factories.description: Read one form's fields, with each field's ref, type, title, and choices, and its hidden field names.

inputSchema.description: GetFormInput names the form to read.

formId.description: FormID is the form ID, such as the formPicker unit's formId or u6nXL7 from https://form.typeform.com/to/u6nXL7.

factories.name: new_list_responses_step
factories.description: List one bounded page, 1 to 1000, of a form's completed responses, newest first, filtered by since and until and paged with the before or after response token.

inputSchema.description: ListResponsesInput selects one page of a form's completed responses, newest submission first.

after.description: After keeps responses submitted after the response with this token, such as the newest token a Flow already processed; blank has no lower cursor. Set Before or After, not both.

before.description: Before keeps responses submitted before the response with this token, such as an earlier page's NextBeforeToken; blank starts at the newest response.

formId.description: FormID is the form ID, such as the formPicker unit's formId.

pageSize.description: PageSize is 1 to 1000 responses; zero uses Typeform's default of 25.

since.description: Since keeps responses submitted at or after this time, to the second; zero has no lower bound.

until.description: Until keeps responses submitted at or before this time, to the second; zero has no upper bound.

factories.name: new_upsert_webhook_step
factories.description: Create or replace a form's webhook with the given tag, URL, and enabled state, signed with the connection's webhook_secret. The PUT is idempotent by tag, so a repeated call leaves one webhook.

inputSchema.description: UpsertWebhookInput creates or replaces the webhook a form has under Tag.

disabled.description: IsDisabled stores the webhook without delivering to it; false enables delivery.

formId.description: FormID is the form ID, such as the formPicker unit's formId.

tag.description: Tag names the webhook within the form, such as dex-response-recorder; the same tag always updates the same webhook.

url.description: URL is the public HTTPS URL where the application mounts the responseSubmitted endpoint, such as https://example.com/webhooks/typeform. Typeform rejects new http URLs.
